abstract: Firms may under‐ or over‐invest in risk management from the social planner's perspective, resulting in a negative externality on other economic agents in the supply chain. The externality of risk management is particularly relevant for agrifood supply chains, which frequently experience disruptions and play a primary role in preventing major social losses from food insecurity. The magnitude of the externality depends on the structure of the supply chain. We build a theoretical model to characterize such externalities in US food supply chains where intermediary firms choose output quantities and investments in managing risks. The model allows for flexible market structures and interdependence of risk management among firms. Risk interdependence captures the unique feature of biotic hazards (e.g., animal and plant diseases) in agrifood supply chains, where the effectiveness of a firm's risk management depends on peer firms' behavior. We offer novel insights on the role of risk interdependence in driving the externality in risk management under different market structures. We show that private firms invest less than the socially optimal level under perfect competition, but risk interdependence and market power introduce complex incentives in risk‐reducing investment that shape the externality. In particular, when investments are complements across firms and firms possess strong market power in production but limited coordination in risk management, private investment may equal or even exceed the socially optimal level.
abstract_zh: 从社会规划者的视角来看，企业在风险管理上的投资可能不足或过度，从而对供应链中的其他经济主体产生负外部性。风险管理的这种外部性在农业食品供应链中尤为突出，因为该供应链频繁遭受中断，并在防止粮食不安全带来的重大社会损失中扮演关键角色。外部性的规模取决于供应链的结构。我们构建了一个理论模型，用以刻画美国食品供应链中的此类外部性，其中中间商企业选择产出数量并进行风险管理投资。该模型允许灵活的市场结构以及企业间风险管理的相互依存性。风险相互依存性捕捉了农业食品供应链中生物性危害（如动植物疫病）的独特特征，即企业风险管理的有效性取决于同行企业的行为。我们提供了关于风险相互依存性在不同市场结构下驱动风险管理外部性作用的新见解。我们表明，在完全竞争条件下，私营企业的投资低于社会最优水平，但风险相互依存性和市场力量引入了复杂的风险削减投资激励，从而塑造了外部性。特别是，当企业间的投资具有互补性，且企业在生产中拥有强大市场力量但在风险管理上协调有限时，私营投资可能等于甚至超过社会最优水平。
title: Risk management externalities in agrifood supply chains
title_zh: 农产品供应链中的风险管理外部性

abstract: We document, using Finnish employer-employee matched panel data, that more productive firms are more likely to hire internally than externally. This result is interpreted via a new theoretical model in which the superior management practices of high-productivity firms enable their managers to screen internal candidates more accurately when recruiting across multiple applicant pools to fill a vacancy. More internal hiring usually results. The model’s further predictions are empirically supported, e.g., internal hiring rates increase in applicant pool size, education level of the internal pool, and managerial performance and education.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰雇主-雇员匹配面板数据记录到，生产率更高的企业更倾向于内部招聘而非外部招聘。这一结果通过一个新的理论模型进行解释，在该模型中，高生产率企业的卓越管理实践使其管理者在填补职位空缺时，能够更准确地筛选多个申请者池中的内部候选人。这通常导致更多的内部招聘。模型的进一步预测得到了实证支持，例如，内部招聘率随申请者池规模、内部池的教育水平以及管理绩效和教育程度的提高而上升。
title: Firm Productivity and the Internal-Versus-External Hiring Decision
title_zh: 企业生产率与内部晋升与外部招聘决策

abstract: In 2008, the US stock market was worth $3 trillion more than the combined European stock market; in 2023, the gap was $34 trillion. This column argues that the valuation gap is not driven by differences in GDP, number of listed firms, sectoral composition, or the presence of a few superstar firms, but by European firms’ inability to scale. European firms remain tethered to their home market. Small European firms face a much larger cost of capital and cannot substitute debt with access to equity financing, including venture capital. Therefore, even if they have profitable growth opportunities, European firms cannot grow as their US counterparts.
abstract_zh: 2008年，美国股市市值比欧洲股市总和高出3万亿美元；到2023年，这一差距扩大至34万亿美元。本专栏认为，这一估值差距并非源于GDP差异、上市公司数量、行业结构或少数超级明星企业的存在，而是由于欧洲企业缺乏扩张能力。欧洲企业始终受制于本土市场。小型欧洲企业面临更高的资本成本，且无法以债务融资替代股权融资渠道，包括风险投资。因此，即便拥有盈利增长机会，欧洲企业也难以像美国同行那样实现成长。
authors: Bo Becker, Efraim Benmelech, Joao Monteiro
title: Small and stuck: Why European firms can’t scale
title_zh: 小而困：为何欧洲企业难以规模化

abstract: Households do not simply choose how much macroeconomic information to acquire; they choose among sources that differ in representativeness and credibility. Using a survey of 46,285 consumers in 47 countries, this column shows that reliance on shopping, utility bills, and other local signals is associated with larger macroeconomic perception and expectation errors. Households that use official reports, newspapers, and television for information make smaller errors. Crucially, distrust of governments and central banks helps explain why more representative aggregate information is dismissed.
abstract_zh: 家庭并非简单地选择获取多少宏观经济信息；他们是在代表性和可信度各异的信源之间做出选择。基于对47个国家46,285名消费者的调查，本专栏显示，依赖购物、公用事业账单及其他本地信号与更大的宏观经济认知和预期误差相关。而使用官方报告、报纸和电视获取信息的家庭，其误差较小。关键在于，对政府和中央银行的不信任有助于解释为何更具代表性的总体信息被忽视。
title: Why more information can make macroeconomic expectations less accurate: Global evidence from 47 countries
title_zh: 为何更多信息反而使宏观经济预期更不准确：来自47个国家的全球证据
